name: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
note_en: In January 2026 a16z announced $15B raised across five new funds (its largest haul ever, led by a $6.75B Growth fund), and in May 2026 its crypto arm closed a fifth fund at $2.2B; firmwide AUM is now roughly $90B+.
note_zh: a16z 於 2026 年 1 月宣布跨五檔新基金募得 150 億美元(史上最大規模,其中成長基金達 67.5 億美元),並於 2026 年 5 月由旗下加密部門完成第五檔 22 億美元基金;全公司管理資產規模已達約 900 億美元以上。
source_title: A16z Raises $15B In New Funds, Its Largest Haul To Date — Crunchbase News

name: Sequoia Capital
note_en: Leadership transitioned in November 2025 as Roelof Botha stepped aside and Alfred Lin and Pat Grady became co-stewards; in April 2026 they raised ~$7B for Sequoia's biggest-ever late-stage expansion fund, doubling down on AI.
note_zh: Sequoia 於 2025 年 11 月完成領導交棒,Roelof Botha 卸任、由 Alfred Lin 與 Pat Grady 共同接掌;兩人於 2026 年 4 月為公司史上最大的後期擴張基金募得約 70 億美元,加碼押注 AI。
source_title: New leaders, new fund: Sequoia has raised $7B to expand its AI bets — TechCrunch

name: AppWorks (之初)
note_en: On 7 January 2026 AppWorks held the final close of Fund IV at $165M, lifting total funds raised to $386M, with three sovereign LPs (Taiwan's National Development Fund, Malaysia's Jelawang Capital, and Korea's KVIC) joining a single vehicle for the first time.
note_zh: AppWorks 於 2026 年 1 月 7 日完成第四號基金最終關閉,規模 1.65 億美元,累計募資總額達 3.86 億美元;台灣國發基金、馬來西亞 Jelawang Capital 與韓國 KVIC 三家主權 LP 首度共同進駐同一檔基金。
source_title: AppWorks closes Fund IV to lift total funds raised to $386M — TNGlobal

name: Index Ventures
note_en: No major new flagship raise in 2025-2026; latest known: in July 2024 Index announced $2.3B across two funds ($800M venture Fund XII and $1.5B Growth VII), and a January 2026 Bloomberg feature noted ~1,100% returns and a generational transition underway.
note_zh: 2025-2026 年無重大新旗艦募資;最新進展:Index 於 2024 年 7 月宣布跨兩檔基金募得 23 億美元(8 億美元創投第十二號基金與 15 億美元成長第七號基金),且 2026 年 1 月彭博報導指其報酬率約 1,100%、正進行世代交替。
source_title: Index launches $2.3bn in new funds — Index Ventures

name: Peak XV Partners
note_en: On 20 February 2026 Peak XV (ex-Sequoia India/SEA) closed $1.3B across India seed, India venture, and APAC funds — its first major independent raise since the 2023 Sequoia split — bringing total AUM above $10B, amid notable early-2026 partner departures (Ashish Agrawal, Ishaan Mittal).
note_zh: Peak XV(前 Sequoia 印度/東南亞)於 2026 年 2 月 20 日完成跨印度種子、印度創投與亞太基金共 13 億美元募資,為 2023 年自 Sequoia 分拆後首次重大獨立募資,使總管理資產突破 100 億美元;同期 2026 年初有合夥人(Ashish Agrawal、Ishaan Mittal)離職創業。
source_title: Peak XV raises $1.3B, doubles down on AI — TechCrunch

name: Hashed
note_en: In 2025 Hashed secured a strategic investment from Japan's SMBC Nikko Securities (SMFG group) into its Venture Fund III, and in December 2025 published its 'Protocol Economy 2026' thesis pivoting toward infrastructure, stablecoins, RWA, and on-chain enterprise systems over narrative-driven projects.
note_zh: Hashed 於 2025 年取得日本 SMBC 日興證券(三井住友金融集團)對其第三號創投基金的策略性投資,並於 2025 年 12 月發布「Protocol Economy 2026」投資論述,將重心轉向基礎建設、穩定幣、實體資產代幣化(RWA)與鏈上企業系統,而非題材導向的專案。
source_title: Crypto's Next Breakout Will Come From Infrastructure, Hashed Says — CoinDesk

name: Pitango
note_en: In November 2025 Pitango closed $300M across two early-stage funds — Pitango First (AI, infrastructure, quantum, cyber, cloud) and Pitango HealthTech — amid a strong run of exits including the Via IPO, PsiQuantum's $1B round, and the Vertos acquisition.
note_zh: Pitango 於 2025 年 11 月完成兩檔早期基金共 3 億美元募資——Pitango First(AI、基礎建設、量子、資安、雲端)與 Pitango HealthTech——同期出場表現亮眼,包括 Via 上市、PsiQuantum 的 10 億美元募資輪與 Vertos 被收購。
source_title: Pitango closes $300m for early-stage, healthcare VC funds — Globes

name: JAFCO
note_en: On 12 December 2025 JAFCO announced its SV8 series — its first flagship fund in three and a half years and its largest ever — with ¥50B raised toward a ¥100B (~$680M) target, focused on social-impact deep tech including AI, space, and nuclear fusion.
note_zh: JAFCO 於 2025 年 12 月 12 日宣布 SV8 系列基金,為其三年半以來首檔旗艦基金、亦是史上規模最大,已募得 500 億日圓、目標 1,000 億日圓(約 6.8 億美元),聚焦含 AI、太空與核融合等具社會影響力的深科技。
source_title: JAFCO to Launch ¥100 Billion Fund Focusing on AI, Space & Nuclear Fusion — Caproasia

name: East Ventures
note_en: In February 2025 East Ventures and Korea's SV Investment announced the first close of a $100M Southeast Asia-South Korea corridor fund (anchored by Korea Development Bank), targeting biotech/healthcare, future mobility, green tech, and media; firmwide AUM is around $1B.
note_zh: East Ventures 與韓國 SV Investment 於 2025 年 2 月宣布一檔 1 億美元東南亞-南韓走廊基金的首次關閉(由韓國產業銀行 KDB 領投),鎖定生技/醫療、未來移動、綠色科技與媒體;全公司管理資產約 10 億美元。
source_title: East Ventures, SV Investment announce first close of $100M corridor fund — TNGlobal

name: OMERS Ventures
note_en: In July 2025 OMERS Ventures laid off much of its US team (headcount cut from 19 to 12) and its most senior VC leader Michael Yang departed, as the Canadian pension's venture arm refocused on the domestic Canadian market — following its 2023 exit from Europe.
note_zh: OMERS Ventures 於 2025 年 7 月裁撤大部分美國團隊(人數由 19 減至 12),最資深創投主管 Michael Yang 離職,這家加拿大退休金的創投部門將重心轉回加拿大本土市場——延續其 2023 年退出歐洲的收縮策略。
source_title: OMERS Ventures drops senior VC leader amid US layoffs and shift in investment focus — Benefits and Pensions Monitor

name: Antler
note_en: In January 2026 Antler closed $510M in new global funds (with half earmarked for US founders and a new San Francisco residency), pushing total global capital above $1B; LPs include the New Mexico State Investment Council and Denmark's EIFO.
note_zh: Antler 於 2026 年 1 月完成 5.1 億美元全球新基金募資(其中一半保留給美國創辦人,並新設舊金山 residency 計畫),使全球累計資本突破 10 億美元;LP 包括新墨西哥州投資委員會與丹麥 EIFO。
source_title: Antler bags $510M in new funds, half for US founders — TechFundingNews

name: Y Combinator
note_en: Now running four cohorts a year (since 2025) of roughly 140-200 companies each — Winter 2026 funded 196 — with acceptance rates at record lows (Summer 2025 reported ~0.6%); CEO Garry Tan has pushed an AI-native thesis, noting ~25% of recent startups had ~95% of their code written by AI.
note_zh: YC 自 2025 年起改為每年四個梯次,每梯約 140-200 家公司(2026 冬季梯次投資 196 家),錄取率創新低(2025 夏季梯次據報約 0.6%);執行長 Garry Tan 主推 AI 原生論述,並指近期約四分之一的新創有約 95% 程式碼由 AI 撰寫。
source_title: Y Combinator Acceptance Rate 2026: What the Data Shows — We Are Founders
